title: Heart Like A Wheel
notes:
Recorded June-September, 1974

Track B2 as printed on the label, sleeve shows it as, "Willin".
Track B3 as printed on the label, sleeve shows it as, "I Can't Help It If I'm Still In Love With You"
Original Inner cardboard sleeve 

[a249836] appears courtesy of [l157]
[a379742] appears courtesy of [l33574]
[a83609] & [a353617] appear courtesy of [l1000]

Recorded and mixed at The Sound Factory, L.A.
Additional recording done at:
Clover Recorders, L.A. ([a=John Haeny])
Record Plant, N.Y. ([a=Dennis Ferante])
Track Recorders, Md. ([a=George Massenburg])
Trident Studios, London ([a=Peter Kelsey])
Air Studios, London ([a=Peter Swettenham])


Runouts are etched.
